decision_5seed.rule:
Frozen rule: highest seed-mean INNER_A Sharpe (consolidated inner block) among arms whose seeds are all valid
    (the three of the run, plus any --pool-suffix seed extension of the same recipe and support); ties -> fewer
    parameters, then the declared control. Reads only INNER_A fields; 2024 is never consulted for a choice.

stage_b_rule: stage B: same frozen rule over its arms (winner_aux, winner_minimal_state, winner_multires_aux) plus the inherited winner's own result as the reference; highest 3-seed mean INNER_A Sharpe among all-valid; ties -> fewer parameters, then the inherited winner unchanged; 2024 one read, never decides

rules.holds: an arm HOLDS only if its seed-ensemble validation Sharpe minus one Lo standard error is > 0 in BOTH walk-forward folds (wf2022 and wf2023); otherwise DOES_NOT_HOLD
rules.separable: two arms are SEPARABLE on a window only when |Sharpe_a - Sharpe_b| > the pooled Lo standard error sqrt(SE_a^2 + SE_b^2); otherwise NOT_SEPARABLE

B_winner_aux.rule: two arms are SEPARABLE on a window only when |Sharpe_a - Sharpe_b| > the pooled Lo standard error sqrt(SE_a^2 + SE_b^2); otherwise NOT_SEPARABLE

B_winner_multires_aux.rule: two arms are SEPARABLE on a window only when |Sharpe_a - Sharpe_b| > the pooled Lo standard error sqrt(SE_a^2 + SE_b^2); otherwise NOT_SEPARABLE
